invariants.description: closed-loop blood volume is conserved: the network total (heart + 5 vessels) stays at its initial value
q_heart is the sum of the four chamber volumes
LV volume balance: q_lv(t) - q_lv(0) = integral of (v_miv - v_aov) (trapezoid on the output grid)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(q_lv - q_lv[0] - np.concatenate([[0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*((v_miv - v_aov)[1:] + (v_miv - v_aov)[:-1])*np.diff(t))]))) <= 5e-3*np.ptp(q_lv)

invariants.description: RV volume balance: q_rv(t) - q_rv(0) = integral of (v_trv - v_puv)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(q_rv - q_rv[0] - np.concatenate([[0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*((v_trv - v_puv)[1:] + (v_trv - v_puv)[:-1])*np.diff(t))]))) <= 5e-3*np.ptp(q_rv)

invariants.description: LV pressure-volume law holds exactly: u_lv = (e_v E_lv_A + E_lv_B)(q_lv - q_lv_us)
RA pressure-volume law holds exactly: u_ra = (e_a E_ra_A + E_ra_B)(q_ra - q_ra_us)
activation functions e_a, e_v stay in [0, 1] and both reach full activation (max > 0.99) every run
all four chamber volumes stay positive
valve effective areas stay within [M_rg A_nn, M_st A_nn] (valve state 0 <= zeta <= 1; zeta is clamped below by max(zeta_pre, 0) but not above, so 1e-4 relative numerical overshoot is allowed)
invariants.expr: (np.min(A_eff_aov) >= M_rg_aov*A_nn_aov*(1 - 1e-6) - 1e-12) & (np.max(A_eff_aov) <= M_st_aov*A_nn_aov*(1 + 1e-4)) & (np.min(A_eff_miv) >= M_rg_miv*A_nn_miv*(1 - 1e-6) - 1e-12) & (np.max(A_eff_miv) <= M_st_miv*A_nn_miv*(1 + 1e-4)) & (np.min(A_eff_trv) >= M_rg_trv*A_nn_trv*(1 - 1e-6) - 1e-12) & (np.max(A_eff_trv) <= M_st_trv*A_nn_trv*(1 + 1e-4)) & (np.min(A_eff_puv) >= M_rg_puv*A_nn_puv*(1 - 1e-6) - 1e-12) & (np.max(A_eff_puv) <= M_st_puv*A_nn_puv*(1 + 1e-4))

invariants.description: valves: backflow volume over the last cycle is < 5% of the forward volume, for all four valves (M_rg = 0: closure transients only)
invariants.expr: (-np.sum(np.minimum(v_aov, 0)[t >= t[-1] - T]) <= 0.05*np.sum(np.maximum(v_aov, 0)[t >= t[-1] - T])) & (-np.sum(np.minimum(v_miv, 0)[t >= t[-1] - T]) <= 0.05*np.sum(np.maximum(v_miv, 0)[t >= t[-1] - T])) & (-np.sum(np.minimum(v_trv, 0)[t >= t[-1] - T]) <= 0.05*np.sum(np.maximum(v_trv, 0)[t >= t[-1] - T])) & (-np.sum(np.minimum(v_puv, 0)[t >= t[-1] - T]) <= 0.05*np.sum(np.maximum(v_puv, 0)[t >= t[-1] - T]))

invariants.description: periodic steady state (after pre_time): q_lv, q_rv, q_la change by < 1% of their range over the last cycle
invariants.expr: (abs(q_lv[-1] - q_lv[np.argmin(np.abs(t - (t[-1] - T)))]) <= 0.01*np.ptp(q_lv)) & (abs(q_rv[-1] - q_rv[np.argmin(np.abs(t - (t[-1] - T)))]) <= 0.01*np.ptp(q_rv)) & (abs(q_la[-1] - q_la[np.argmin(np.abs(t - (t[-1] - T)))]) <= 0.01*np.ptp(q_la))

invariants.description: at steady state LV and RV eject the same volume per beat (within 2%)
invariants.expr: abs(np.sum(v_aov[t >= t[-1] - T]) - np.sum(v_puv[t >= t[-1] - T])) <= 0.02*np.sum(v_aov[t >= t[-1] - T])

invariants.description: the LV pressure oscillates with the heart period T (within 1%)

bc_sweep.rationale: Heart timing: T 0.6-1.5 s (HR 40-100 bpm; T_vc + T_vr = 0.49 s bounds T below), T_vc/T_vr/T_ac/T_ar about their Liang 2009 values within physiological bounds, t_astart 0.6-0.95 s (atrial kick in late diastole), t_vstart 0-0.1 s. Elastances, unstressed and initial volumes, valve rate constants K_vo/K_vc, annulus areas, l_eff, v_ref: x0.5-2 of nominal (covers the healthy spread and the control-driven changes Delta_E). M_rg 0-0.05 (mild regurgitant orifice), M_st 0.5-1 (up to moderate stenosis); A_nn_trv only 4-10 cm2, because above ~10.2 cm2 the RA volume goes negative (linear P-V law allows suction, u_ra < 0; recorded as a finding). rho 1040-1070 kg/m3 (blood). u_intraThor +-1 kPa (+-7.5 mmHg, respiratory swing), Delta_T -0.4..0.5 s (baroreflex period changes; T_min floor), Delta_E_lv +-100 MPa/m3 and Delta_E_rv +-30 MPa/m3 (inotropic control), R_ASD 1e6-1e8 Pa s/m3 (large to small defect). The inputs connected by the harness network (u_root, u_par, v_ivc, v_svc, v_pvn) are not parameters of the network model and are excluded. Invariants marked applies: run (steady state, backflow, period) are checked at the nominal point only, since the sweep deliberately includes regurgitant valves and slow transients.

baseline.source: maceira2006normalized; Table 8, all subjects (n = 120, 60 men / 60 women, SSFP CMR): EDV 142 +- 21 ml, ESV 47 +- 10 ml, SV 95 +- 14 ml, EF 67 +- 4.6 %. Pressures: Table 1 brachial cuff blood pressure, range of the age-decile means of men and women (systolic 115-135, diastolic 68-79 mmHg); brachial, not central aortic, pressure, so the pressure targets are approximate. Checked directly in the scmr.org PDF of the paper. A target passes when |model - mean| <= 2 SD, or the model lies in the range.
